subject.title: fix(review): reconcile terminal legacy v2 publications

question: Should maintainers accept this additional protocol-v2 reconciliation path as an authorized eligibility rule for removing terminal, ownerless durable publication rows?
rationale: The patch is mechanically bounded and has focused proof, but the remaining choice is operational policy: whether successful producer provenance plus terminal-target and authority checks is sufficient to delete this durable state class.

options.title: Approve the bounded v2 path
options.body: Accept the added protocol-v2 eligibility rule while retaining manual, dry-run-first production operation and the existing 100-row bound.

options.title: Require production dry-run evidence first
options.body: Keep the PR open until a maintainer reviews a redacted live dry-run showing the new counters and protected-row outcomes for the relevant queue state.

options.title: Keep v2 rows retained
options.body: Decline this maintenance policy and leave protocol-v2 rows for separate manual investigation rather than automated reconciliation.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded v2 path
recommendation.body: Accept the added protocol-v2 eligibility rule while retaining manual, dry-run-first production operation and the existing 100-row bound.
